manufacturer_installation.custom_stack: Do not automatically reinterpret the original-wall limit as approval of the added custom plate/bedding stack. Final gasket compression, nut seating, cover clearance and handle engagement remain to be checked.

foam.description: Compressible perimeter gasket on the wall-facing side of the removable inner plate; absent from the exposed installation when that plate is removed.
foam.unverified: Exact rear footprint, continuity, material grade, condition and installed compression. The explanatory rear-view drawing is schematic, not a gasket template.

assumptions: Both installed rods are uncut 115.824 mm factory studs.
Rod axes are perpendicular to the finished tile plane for this calculation.
Existing scan scale, tile datum and tip locations are sufficiently representative; none is newly physically verified.
The wood face is not registered to the scan. Rear-photo contact does not supply its depth.

photo_inference: The visible rod appears to meet the wood surface. Surface contact is the leading interpretation, but a shallow indentation or obscured hole cannot be excluded; the second stud's rear end is not resolved.
decisive_inspection: Trace each diagonal front trim stud to its rear end. A grazing-angle mirror/borescope view can show whether its end face sits above wood or disappears into a hole. If actual rod length L is known, compare the front-tip-to-near-wood-face distance D measured along that rod: D approximately L suggests contact; D less than L implies penetration L-D; D greater than L implies a gap D-L. Differences must exceed measurement uncertainty. A paper feeler passing establishes a gap; failure to pass does not distinguish contact from penetration.
physical_work: None. No stud rotation, cutting, drilling, valve movement or fabrication release.
